The House Committee on Regulated Industries offers Senate Bill 553 By: Senators Hatchett of the following substitute to SB 553: 50th, Walker III of the 20th, Cowsert of the 46th, Brass of the 6th, Payne of the 54th and others AS PASSED
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to professions and businesses, so as to repeal Chapter 14, relating to electrical contractors, plumbers, conditioned air contractors, low … 1724 (C) Tier three: has 300 or fewer employees or $30 million or less in gross receipts per 1725 year."
1726
SECTION 4. 1727 All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
